gunpla_monster: Roland Monster took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.

During a lull at Sorrow Copse, Silas "Mud" Samhatespeac called across from the Concord line. Roland Monster answered from the Hegemony side with a convincing imitation of an officer. Both trenches went quiet. The sergeant read out the order: Verdel Ridge has fallen, hold the line. Roland Monster looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
A bullet went through Roland Monster's sleeve at S-F7 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Dorian "Whistle" Csllgaks of the Concord (@csllgaks).

Roland Monster's wound turned bad. The bandage was not enough and he was carried back to wait for a bed. A letter from home found Roland Monster before the night shift. Roland Monster folded it small and kept it close.
Roland Monster spent the day on a stretcher outside the aid post, waiting for a bed to come free. The bearers brought water twice.
mearsiecat: In Rosenau, Konrad Mearsiecat was a coal miner. In R-F3, he is a number and a rifle. He has told everyone he intends to be a coal miner again.
Konrad Mearsiecat borrowed a book with three readers already waiting in line. For once, everyone was impatient about something harmless.
Konrad Mearsiecat went out with the wiring party at R-F3. Crawl, hammer a stake, pull the wire, crawl back. Nobody was hit.
mr.unstoppable213: Ulrich Unstoppable told the sergeant he was a coal miner. The sergeant said the war needed one of those like it needed a hole in the roof, and put him on sentry.
Ulrich Unstoppable fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Bastian Nodrag, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything.
A supply man offered Ulrich Unstoppable a damaged gramophone in exchange for help unloading. He accepted before asking whether there were any records.
